purpose: Source extraction and conservative module file candidates; not semantic membership
known_limits: Physical package ownership and file candidates do not establish logical module membership
Seven declarations are conservatively deferred due to cfg_attr context
Default file layout assumes ordinary loading; custom macro/include contexts are not resolved
Inline path overrides and non-module ancestors are deferred
No cfg evaluation, macro expansion, type checking or runtime evidence
Unsupported node kinds and non-top-level Verbatim are not fully inventoried
No duplicate candidates or refactoring recommendations are produced
